channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2026 USTA October Level 4 Open (MON 10/5)
item.description: Sat 10/3 – Mon 10/5 · times not yet published | Mobile Tennis Center | No published price. A USTA Level 4 open draws roughly 200 players from around the country to the Mobile Tennis Center over three days. Match times and any spectator admission are not published on the host page, and the host's own address for the venue misspells the street name that USTA's own venue contact page corrects to Gaillard Drive.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (MON 10/5)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (MON 10/5)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (MON 10/5)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (MON 10/5)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (MON 10/5)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Songwriters Festival (cherry-pick sets) (MON 10/5)
item.description: Oct 1-11 · venue-by-venue schedule | 22+ venues, Pensacola Beach + downtown | Free. Ten days of acoustic storyteller rounds run, mostly free, a build-your-own date. Many venues are bars; the cleaner picks are the daytime Gulfside Pavilion sets and restaurant listening rooms (Native Café, Flounders dinner sets).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (MON 10/5)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (MON 10/5)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: 2026 ALA-CASE Fall Conference (MON 10/5)
item.description: Sunday 10/4 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Perdido Beach Resort | No published price. Perdido Beach Resort hosts the 2026 ALA-CASE Fall Conference on Sunday, October 4, from 8 AM to 5 PM. Alabama special education administrators and education leaders gather for professional learning across the day. The conference returns every year.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (MON 10/5)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Billiards (MON 10/5)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Open-play billiards runs on the two pool tables at the Niceville Senior Center. City of Niceville residents get free membership, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate to play. The city says no experience is needed, so beginners and experienced players are equally welcome.

item.title: Café Social & Games (MON 10/5)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's 1950s-themed cafe hosts a casual social day with coffee and donated snacks. Members can settle into Rummikub, card games, puzzles, or dominoes at their own pace. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (MON 10/5)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (MON 10/5)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (MON 10/5)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Shuffleboard Open Play (MON 10/5)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center opens its shuffleboard courts to members age 55 and up for casual, all-skill-levels play throughout the day. The center frames it as relaxed social play with a little friendly competition, not a formal league. City of Niceville residents get free Senior Center membership. The open play session also repeats on weekdays through October.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (MON 10/5)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (MON 10/5)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Indios Amigos: Traveling Exhibit at the Valparaiso Library (MON 10/5)
item.description: Mon 10/5 to Fri 10/9 · 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Valparaiso Library | No published price. The Valparaiso Library hosts Indios Amigos, a traveling exhibit made by the Florida Public Archaeology Network and the UWF Archaeology Institute, for Hispanic Heritage Month. The library says this is the only Okaloosa County stop for the exhibit, and it is open 9 AM to 5 PM through Friday, October 9. The listing is for families and everyone.

item.title: Maker Days at Emerald Coast Science Center (MON 10/5)
item.description: Monday 10/5 · 9:00 AM | Emerald Coast Science Center | No published price. A hands-on maker program at the science center. The center's own page notes spaces are limited and asks families to reserve a spot by emailing website@ecscience.org before the day.

item.title: Ping Pong Meet-Up (MON 10/5)
item.description: 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This ping pong meetup at the Niceville Senior Center is open to beginners and experienced players alike, and the city says no experience is required to join in. It runs Wednesday mid morning and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (MON 10/5)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (MON 10/5)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Messy Monday (MON 10/5)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Children's Park | No published price. Messy Monday is a recurring City of Niceville program held at Children's Park.

item.title: Mexican Train Dominoes (MON 10/5)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Mexican Train Dominoes at the Niceville Senior Center is pitched as easy to learn, welcoming first-time players alongside the regulars. It runs Wednesday late morning into early afternoon and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: DiscipleStory (MON 10/5)
item.description: Sundays 9/13 – 10/18 (of an 8-week class) · 11:00 AM (end time not published) | Crosspoint Niceville Campus, Room 912 | No published price. An eight-week Sunday morning class at Crosspoint's Niceville campus walks participants through identifying their own story, passions, abilities and role in the church's mission. The class starts September 13 at 11 AM; the campus newsletter does not publish an end time.

item.title: Summer's End at Quayside Art Gallery (MON 10/5)
item.description: Daily through 10/5 · 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Quayside Art Gallery | No published price. Quayside Art Gallery in downtown Pensacola is showing Summer's End, an exhibition about the turn from late summer into autumn, through October 5. Four artists fill the show with changing landscapes, vacation memories and the amber light of late summer evenings. The gallery is a locally owned artist co-op with three floors of work by more than 50 local artists, and it opens every day from 11 AM to 5 PM.

item.title: Hearts Card Game (MON 10/5)
item.description: 1:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. The Niceville Senior Center opens its doors on Wednesday afternoons for a drop in game of Hearts, welcoming beginners and experienced players alike. No reservation is needed, so you can just show up and find a table. The center is open to members age 55 and up, and City of Niceville residents get free membership. Non-resident membership pricing isn't published, so call ahead.

item.title: Chess Club at West (MON 10/5)
item.description: Mondays · 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts an all ages chess club for beginners and experienced players. The library says the group meets every Monday afternoon at this location, so it is easy to build into a routine.

item.title: Make & Take Art: weekly drop-in art sessions (MON 10/5)
item.description: Thursdays 8/27 through 10/15 (except Sept 8) · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Mobile Museum of Art | Free. The museum runs a free Thursday afternoon art session most weeks, working through materials and techniques borrowed from artists on view. Projects range from geometric shape painting to a Basquiat-inspired dinosaur build. The printed schedule also lists a session for September 8, but that date falls on a Tuesday, not a Thursday, so check with the museum first.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach: paint nights and all-ages sessions (weekly programme) (MON 10/5)
item.description: Classes most weeks: Sunday 3 PM, Monday evenings, Saturday all-ages open studio | Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach | from $27. Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach is an artist-led canvas painting studio at 255 Miracle Strip Pkwy SE, Suite B-8, in the Publix shopping center in downtown Fort Walton Beach. October has an all-ages open studio, Halloween sessions, a book-lovers paint night and blacklight painting. Standard canvases cost $37-$39, all-ages sessions $27-$60 and Paint Your Pet $57-$59, and the studio is BYOB-friendly.

item.title: The Young Writers Room (MON 10/5)
item.description: Mondays · 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM | Parkway Branch Library | No published price. Parkway Branch Library sets aside its meeting room for young writers, a space for kids and teens who like to create and think through ideas on the page. Sessions are set for Mondays, October 5 and October 19, from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

item.title: Youth Chess Club at the Crestview Library (MON 10/5)
item.description: Mondays · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Crestview Library | No published price. The Crestview Library runs a Youth Chess Club every Monday afternoon for school-age players. The club is built to teach new players the game and to help experienced players improve.

item.title: Chess Club at Saraland (MON 10/5)
item.description: Mondays · 3:30 PM to 5:30 PM | Saraland Public Library | No published price. Chess players of all ages and skill levels gather at the Saraland Public Library to learn fundamentals or sharpen their strategy. It is a welcoming group for total beginners as well as experienced players.

item.title: TBS Comics Fort Walton Beach weekly game nights (Yu-Gi-Oh, D&D, Magic, Lorcana, One Piece and more) (MON 10/5)
item.description: Game nights Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday · from 5 PM | TBS Comics Fort Walton Beach | No published price. TBS Comics Fort Walton Beach hosts weekly game nights at its shop on Mary Esther Blvd. Monday is Yu-Gi-Oh at 6 PM, and Tuesday is D&D Adventurers League at 5 PM. Wednesday has casual Magic all day and Digimon at 6 PM, and Friday has Magic Commander at 6 PM and Yu-Gi-Oh at 7 PM.

item.title: TBS Comics Pensacola weekly game nights (Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh, Lorcana, One Piece, D&D and more) (MON 10/5)
item.description: Game nights Monday, Wednesday and Thursday · from 5 PM | TBS Comics Pensacola | No published price. TBS Comics Pensacola hosts weekly game nights at its shop on North 9th Ave. Monday is Magic Commander at 6:30 PM. Wednesday has Marvel Crisis Protocol at 5 PM, Board Game Night at 6 PM, and D&D Adventurers League, Riftbound and Star Wars Unlimited at 6:30 PM. Thursday has Yu-Gi-Oh and Gundam TCG at 6:30 PM and Magic Modern at 7 PM, and Friday has Star Wars Unlimited, Digimon and Magic Commander at 7 PM.

item.title: Rosa Court Jesters: Book Cellar Music (MON 10/5)
item.description: Monday 10/5 · 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM | Page & Palette / Book Cellar | No published price. The Book Cellar inside Page & Palette hosts Mike Estep under the Rosa Court Jesters billing for a night of cover songs, Monday from 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM.

item.title: Adult Open Gym 17+ (MON 10/5)
item.description: Mondays · 6:00 PM to 8:30 PM | Destin Community Center | from $5. Full-court open gym for anyone 17 and older runs every Monday night at the Destin Community Center. The city requires proof of residence at the door.

item.title: Dating with a Purpose (MON 10/5)
item.description: Wednesdays, weekly (no published end date) · 6:00 PM (end time not published) | Crosspoint Niceville Campus, Room 701 | No published price. A Wednesday evening discussion group at Crosspoint's Niceville campus focuses on intentional dating, character and evaluating a shared life vision, starting September 9. The campus newsletter does not publish an end date or an end time.
